name: Flexible Asset Allocation (core 6)
description: Multi-factor momentum strategy (Keller & van Putten, 2012) applied to broader core-6 diversified asset group. Ranks each asset on three factors: trailing return, realized volatility (low-vol favored), and average pairwise correlation to other assets (low-correlation favored). Combines rankings with configurable weights (1.0, 0.5, 0.5) and selects top 3 assets. Applies absolute-momentum gate: drops any selected asset with negative trailing return and redirects weight to safe asset (bonds). Equal-weights survivors.
